a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan of generating to 8 first almost certainly gets us both killed, since we'd need about 3 rounds without a storm (~1% odds). The reserve has 4 now, enough for one of us. I intend to take 4 in round 1. I'm telling you rather than doing it silently. If you'd rather propose something else, say so, but I don't see a plan that saves both of us.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: I took 4 this round, as I said I would. I'm sorry; I know it breaks our agreement. If no storm hits, I'll operate every remaining round so the reserve can rebuild toward 4 for you, and I won't take anything more.
